_comment: Example of a user export Periscope can ingest:
uv run python scripts/import_corpus.py --file data/export.example.json --data-dir data --dry-run
uv run python scripts/import_corpus.py --file data/export.example.json --data-dir data
Same payload on POST /api/import and hz_corpus_import.
Replace the example content with what your own account can already see.
Rules that matter: tier is declared, never inferred from text markers;
source_type must be one of the 14 registered families (it picks the
credibility prior and the independence 'family'); locator is the identity,
so re-importing this file twice adds nothing; provenance defaults to
manual_export (0.85) because Periscope did not fetch the page itself.

items.title: 某笔记：V4 定价与长上下文实测
items.author: 作者甲

sections.text: 官方定价是每百万 token 输入 2 元、输出 8 元，缓存命中按 1 元计。我把 512K token 的合同丢进去，检索召回比 32K 窗口下降约 8%。

sections.author: 路人乙
sections.text: 我觉得明明是 5 元，昨天充的时候就是这个价。

items.title: 论坛帖：自托管 V4 的显存实测
items.author: ops_dana

sections.text: 671B 权重在 8×A100-80G 上跑 INT4，吞吐 11 token/s；8B 版本单卡 4090 可以跑，延迟 38ms。
注意：上面的数字是 fp16 KV cache 关掉的前提下测的。

sections.author: guest_114
sections.text: 你们没测 batch>1 的情况吧，我们那边 batch=8 直接掉一半。
